The JamesSuckling.com team traveled to Seattle earlier in March to meet and interview local talented winemakers, including Charles Smith Wines , Andrew Will Winery , Chateau Ste. Michelle and Betz Family Winery . Intrigued by great style opportunities, the team tasted close to 600 wines in total, where some of them were back vintages that aged particularly well.
